headline: Emirates Group First-Half Profit Plunges 66% Amid Regional War and High Fuel Costs
summary: Emirates Group reported a 66% year-over-year decline in first-half profits, weighed down by regional conflict and high aviation fuel costs.
why: Aviation profit margins are highly sensitive to jet fuel price volatility and geopolitical instability that disrupts regional air traffic.

impacts.name: Emirates Group
impacts.why: Sharp profit declines reflect adverse operating cost pressures and regional disruptions.
